name: Construct Zero
title: Construct Zero — Hermes on Cursor
description: Construct Zero is a local, open-source inference bridge: Hermes is the agent with the tools and memory; Cursor is the model provider your subscription already pays for.
templateLeakPatterns: tracking climate, emissions, and energy data

faq.question: What does Construct Zero do?
faq.answer: It connects Hermes Agent to Cursor subscription models through a local OpenAI-compatible adapter.

faq.question: Does Construct Zero run tools?
faq.answer: No. Hermes owns and executes all terminal, file, web, skill, memory, and gateway work.

faq.question: Does Cursor become a second agent?
faq.answer: No. The Cursor driver stays in ask mode only, providing inference rather than its own agent loop.

faq.question: Do I need another LLM API key?
faq.answer: Not for the main path. You need an active Cursor subscription and a Cursor API key.

faq.question: Is this a hosted cloud service?
faq.answer: No. Construct Zero is designed for localhost, or a VPS accessed through an SSH tunnel.

faq.question: What is the optional voice feature?
faq.answer: A local hold-to-talk sidecar that uses local speech models and speaks verbatim layers from Hermes replies.
